ownership_decision.invariant: Identity resolves the authenticated Session's Workspace only. Run, Creation, Packaging and Publishing remain authoritative for their own Activity facts; the HTTP composition layer may merge but never reinterpret them.

boundary_decision.interaction: Each lifecycle owner exposes a narrow Workspace-scoped Activity facts reader. The composition layer receives those readers through the existing composition root, queries them with the Session-derived Workspace, merges already-classified facts, applies the public cursor and maps typed continuation targets to transport without importing lifecycle owners into one another.
boundary_decision.consistency: Synchronous live reads. Pagination is stable for an unchanged dataset and does not claim a cross-request snapshot. Any contracted owner read failure fails closed with HTTP 503, complete=false and unavailable_sources, without items or a cursor.
prohibited_dependencies: cross-context SQL or generated query row sharing
one lifecycle context importing another to build Activity
analytics events used as lifecycle truth
silent omission of an unavailable contracted source

domain_forces: Returning creators need one place to resume long work without creating a second state machine or losing the exact source object.
Run execution, evaluation, Creation pending actions, Artifact scan and availability, Publication status, Release recency and Catalog exposure are distinct facts.
A cross-source feed needs one authorization boundary, total ordering, explicit source coverage and failure semantics that existing independent lists cannot provide.
Current precise continuations already exist for Run, Creation Session, Artifact and Skill Publication, while Bundle selection does not yet identify an existing Bundle.
The current Run-only UI must keep its scope disclosure until all contracted owner facts are implemented and proven.
implementation_design.decision: Use no new Aggregate, event stream or persisted Activity Context. The first complete source scope is Run, Creation Session, Packaging Artifact and Skill Publication with its latest Release; Bundle Publication and Catalog exposure are excluded. Each owner returns a minimal read DTO with stable identity, display summary, original status, owner classification, authoritative last_updated_at and one typed continuation target. Packaging quarantined remains a defensive mapping rather than evidence of an observable long-running phase. Publishing proposes max(status_changed_at, latest_released_at) as its recency rule for owner review, while Run and Packaging time semantics remain explicit approval blockers. GET /me/activity performs only Workspace-scoped fan-in, deterministic keyset merge, coverage reporting and transport mapping. No tactical domain pattern is introduced because this is a read projection.
invariants_preserved: Workspace scope comes from the authenticated Session and is applied by every owner reader.
Each lifecycle Context remains authoritative for status, actionability and update-time meaning.
Activity is read-only and never changes, repairs or advances source state.
Run execution and evaluation remain separate axes.
Artifact scan status and availability remain separate facts.
Publication, Release and Catalog exposure remain separate facts.
Unknown, unavailable, absent and empty remain distinguishable.
rejected_alternatives: A new persisted Activity Context: current evidence requires a query projection, not another state source with replay and consistency obligations.
Browser-side composition: it cannot establish one authorization boundary, global cursor or truthful source coverage.
Entrypoint status mapping: it would move owner decisions into transport orchestration.
A single cross-context SQL query: it bypasses owner Services and hard-codes unrelated schemas into one read path.
Treating Packaging quarantined as a normal long-running phase: the standard path creates and marks the Artifact available in one transaction.
Including Bundle Publication in the first scope: the current management search selects a member Version, not an existing Bundle.
Treating Catalog exposure as Publishing recency: exposure is an independent operator-owned decision.

contract_change.description: Add GET /me/activity as a Session-authenticated Workspace read endpoint with a discriminated item union, typed continuation union, deterministic global keyset cursor and explicit source coverage.
contract_change.compatibility: Additive. Existing lifecycle list endpoints and /workspace/runs remain compatible. Unknown item kinds remain displayable through stable summary fields, and clients never infer actionability from raw status.
contract_change.data_classification: Workspace-scoped metadata only; excludes Creation Snapshot and prompt, Trace payload, evaluation text, package contents and exposure review findings.
contract_change.retry_behavior: Read-only and idempotent. Any contracted owner read failure returns HTTP 503 with complete=false and unavailable_sources, without items or next_cursor; clients retry the whole read.

open_questions: Which Run changes define authoritative last_updated_at, and must the owner persist a new value?
Which Packaging state-change timestamp must be added, and how is clock-derived expiry represented without inventing a stored transition?
What classification and single continuation action does each owner return for every supported state and attached fact?
